structural_change: QW-COLLIO3 10-21: P profile stamped from qfd_coll_face_s1_pl (PHY-region landing split, owner CLOCK RULE 10-20 08:55; ring pointer copies per 6 bits). QW-COLLIO2 10-21 PHY-region split (owner CLOCK RULE 10-20 08:55) of qfd_coll_face_s1_band4 (codec0 pin-flop spread 450.8 -> 150.3 -> 108.9 / band5 138.5 ps FAIL: one codec0 tree served both the E PHY pin registers and the codec core in the band; pin compaction exhausted). Now the PHY pin registers are their own clock region on a second entry codec0p (E, centred on the PHY pin group) and land to/from the codec core region (codec0, entry moved to S under the band, no boundary pins left) through fixed-latency mesochronous rings ot_coll_meso_ring D=2 K=1 (offset set at reset, no flow control; RX slots = pin capture flops, TX read regs = output pin regs). Ring depth: measured codec0 phase spread <=232 ps << T 833 ps; D2/K1 window setup 1T / hold 1T. Cost: TX +2 / RX +1 edges, face L 378 -> 381 (calendar compensated in RTL; priced via NOTICE QW-TOKSCHED). Same floorplan as band4 otherwise.
